```{python}
#| label: fig-test
#| fig-cap: "Two quantities 1,000 times apart. On a linear axis the small one vanishes."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 2.2))
ax.barh(["Big", "Small"], [1000, 1], color=["#1F1D1A", "#B23A26"])
for s in ["top", "right"]:
    ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
fig.patch.set_alpha(0)
ax.set_facecolor("none")
plt.show()
```
